import asyncio
from threadify import Threadify

async def main():
    # Connect with your API key
    conn = await Threadify.connect("YOUR_API_KEY", service_name="my-service")

    # Start tracking a workflow with a descriptive label
    thread = await conn.start("Order-Processing-ORD-12345")

    # Record each step with full context
    await (
        thread.step("order_placed")
        .add_context({"order_id": "ORD-12345", "amount": "99.99"})
        .success()
    )

    await (
        thread.step("payment_processed")
        .add_context({"payment_id": "PAY-67890"})
        .success()
    )

    await conn.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

with_contracts.python:
import asyncio
from threadify import Threadify

async def main():
    conn = await Threadify.connect("YOUR_API_KEY", service_name="my-service")

    # Start a thread with a label and contract
    thread = await conn.start(
        "Order-Fulfillment-ORD-123",
        contract_name="ecommerce_order"
    )

    # Record steps - Threadify validates against contract
    await (
        thread.step("order_placed")
        .add_context({"items": "3", "total": "299.97"})
        .success()
    )

    await (
        thread.step("payment_processed")
        .add_context({"payment_id": "pay_123"})
        .success()
    )

    await conn.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

with_reactions.python:
import asyncio
from threadify import Threadify

async def main():
    conn = await Threadify.connect("YOUR_API_KEY", service_name="my-service")

    # Subscribe to violations
    conn.subscribe("rule.violated", "payment_processed", lambda n: (
        print("Payment violation:", n.severity),
        # Implement circuit breaker, retry logic, etc.
        n.ack(),
    ))

    # Subscribe to completions
    conn.subscribe("step.success", "order_delivered", lambda n: (
        print("Order delivered:", n.step_name),
        # Send confirmation email, update analytics, etc.
        n.ack(),
    ))

    # Keep connection open to receive notifications
    await asyncio.sleep(3600)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

opentelemetry_integration.python:
import asyncio
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor
from threadify import Threadify

async def setup_otel():
    # 1. Connect to Threadify
    conn = await Threadify.connect("YOUR_API_KEY", service_name="checkout-service")

    # 2. Create the Exporter
    exporter = conn.create_span_exporter(options={"refs": ["order.id"]})

    # 3. Register with OpenTelemetry
    provider = TracerProvider()
    provider.add_span_processor(BatchSpanProcessor(exporter))
    trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)

    # Now all your standard OTel spans automatically become Threadify execution graphs!
    tracer = trace.get_tracer("my-service-tracer")
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("process_payment"):
        pass # ... business logic ...

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(setup_otel())
